function check_result() {
  local package_name="$1"
  local result="$2"
  if [ "$result" == "skipped" ];then
    echo "Skipped $package_name package."
  else
    echo "Checking if $package_name package test passes..."
    test "$result" == "success"
    echo "Passed."
  fi
}
